arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse

# Test RFC 2822 format with different timezone formats
test_cases = [
    ('Mon, 20 Jan 1972 10:21:36 +1000', '+10:00'),
    ('Mon, 20 Jan 1972 10:21:36 +10:00', '+10:00'),
]

for s, expected_name in test_cases:
    result = parse.parse('{:te}', s)
    if result is None:
        print(f'FAIL: {s!r} did not parse')
        continue
    
    tz_info = result.fixed[0].tzinfo
    if tz_info._name != expected_name:
        print(f'FAIL: got name={tz_info._name!r}, expected {expected_name!r}')
    else:
        print(f'OK: {s!r} -> name={tz_info._name!r}')
"
